items.title: Prologis (PLD) Stock Looks Reasonable On Earnings But Stretched On Cash Flow
items.summary: After a 34.1% one year return, Prologis no longer looks obviously cheap, and the current share price of US$139.05 sits close to its intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model. At the same time, the broader valuation checks lean expensive rather than pointing to a clear bargain.
